title: Installation and Permission to Operate on SunPath Systems
content:
**SunPath Solar Lease — installation and permission to operate, in questions and answers for the desk.**

**When is a SunPath system installed?**
The system is installed before the home closes.

**What happens to the lease at installation?**
The lease moves from pending installation to pending PTO: the system is installed and awaits the utility's permission to operate.

**How soon after installation is permission to operate expected?**
Permission to operate is targeted within the system size's permission-to-operate target in calendar days of installation.

**When does the lease term begin?**
When the utility grants permission to operate. The lease then moves from pending PTO to active and the lease term begins.

**Can a lease payment be billed before the first bill date?**
No. No lease payment is billed before the first bill date.

## The rule in one line

Installation comes before closing, permission to operate is targeted within the target period from installation, the term begins at permission to operate, and no lease payment is billed before the first bill date.

## Status at each stage

| Stage | Lease status | Lease payment billed? |
|---|---|---|
| Lease signed, system not yet installed | Pending installation | No |
| System installed, awaiting permission to operate | Pending PTO | No |
| Permission to operate granted, before the first bill date | Active | No |

## Hypothetical case

A system is installed on a given date and the utility grants permission to operate some weeks later. Between those two dates the lease is pending PTO and no lease payment is billed. From the permission-to-operate date the lease is active, and still no lease payment is billed until the first bill date is reached.
